card.name: Uptake and clearance words in interactions
card.fires_on: Nouns for how a drug is moved or handled by the body, such as uptake, clearance, elimination, exposure and transport. They appear in drug interaction text, often after reduced, decreased or increased.

modes.label: Uptake or transport
modes.description: The word uptake or transport about transporters or tissue uptake.
modes.example: Brepocitinib inhibits renal<< uptake>> transporters, OCT2 and MATE

modes.label: Clearance or exposure
modes.description: Clearance, elimination or exposure of a named drug, after a change word.
